question: Who is the one that abides in its own nature while containing all principles and names within itself?
premises: This reality inwardly contains all principles, letters, and related fullness.
It is designated by all names and has Bhairava as its nature.
Such a reality abides in its own essential form.
inference: Therefore the one who partakes of his own nature is none other than Bhairava, containing all within himself.
plain_english: Filled within with all principles, letters, and the rest, bearing all names, and whose very nature is Bhairava, he alone abides in his own true form.
